channel.title: Al-Tarek Attallah — Engineering Notes
channel.description: Practical notes on backend engineering, architecture, databases, AI-assisted development, cloud, DevOps, and SRE.

item.title: From Full Stack Development to DevOps and SRE
item.description: Why I am expanding beyond application development into cloud infrastructure, DevOps, reliability engineering, automation, and scalable systems.

item.title: Preparing for AWS Cloud Practitioner
item.description: My learning journey through AWS Cloud fundamentals and the key concepts behind cloud computing, security, storage, compute, networking, monitoring, and cost optimization.

item.title: My Journey from Science to Software Engineering
item.description: My transition from a scientific and pharmaceutical background into software development, and how analytical thinking, problem solving, and attention to detail became valuable skills in engineering.

item.title: AI-Assisted Software Development
item.description: How AI-assisted development can improve productivity, debugging, documentation, code exploration, and software engineering workflows while keeping developers responsible for architecture and technical decisions.

item.title: MongoDB & Mongoose for Enterprise Applications
item.description: How schema design, validation, relationships, indexes, public identifiers, and soft deletion can be handled when building production-oriented applications with MongoDB and Mongoose.

item.title: Designing RESTful APIs the Right Way
item.description: Practical principles I follow when designing clean, consistent, and maintainable REST APIs.

item.title: What I Learned Building MADMS
item.description: Lessons learned while designing and building a modular enterprise backend, including authentication, RBAC, validation, database design, and business modules.

item.title: From CRUD APIs to Business Logic
item.description: Why real-world enterprise applications require more than basic CRUD operations, and how business rules can be organized into reliable backend services and engines.

item.title: Understanding RBAC in Enterprise Applications
item.description: A practical overview of Role-Based Access Control and how users, roles, permissions, and authorization work together in enterprise applications.

item.title: Building a Scalable Node.js Backend
item.description: How I structure a scalable Node.js backend using separation of concerns, modular architecture, controllers, services, repositories, and models.
